# Pedal node catalog

Every `kind` a pedal node can be, with its fields. A field takes a constant
or a binding (`{"param": ...}` or, where marked modulatable, `{"node": ...}`).
Smoothed fields ease toward a parameter change over the node's `smooth` time.
`cantina-cli kinds` prints the same catalog.

## `input`: Input

The signal coming into the pedal. Exactly one.

*source: takes no audio in.*

No fields.

## `output`: Output

The signal leaving the pedal. Exactly one.

No fields.

## `gain`: Gain

Scales the signal, in decibels or by a multiplier, smoothly.

| Field | Takes | Default | | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `db` | -96 to 96 dB | 0 | modulatable, smoothed | Gain in decibels; eased in the linear domain |
| `linear` | 0 to 16 | 1 | modulatable, smoothed | A plain multiplier instead of decibels; set one or the other |
| `smooth` | 0 to 1 s | 0.005 |  | Seconds a parameter change takes to settle; 0 applies it on the next block |

## `biquad`: Filter

A second-order filter: lowpass, highpass, peak, shelf or notch.

| Field | Takes | Default | | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `lowpass`, `highpass`, `peak`, `lowshelf`, `highshelf`, `notch` | `lowpass` |  | The design: a cut, a bell, a shelf or a notch |
| `freq` | 20 to 20000 Hz | 1000 | modulatable, smoothed | Corner or centre frequency |
| `gain` | -24 to 24 dB | 0 | smoothed | Boost or cut for a peak or shelf; the cuts and the notch ignore it |
| `q` | 0.1 to 10 | 0.707107 | smoothed | Width: 0.7071 is a flat Butterworth cut |
| `smooth` | 0 to 1 s | 0 |  | Seconds a parameter change takes to settle; 0 applies it on the next block |

## `waveshaper`: Waveshaper

Clips or folds the signal through a curve, oversampled so the harmonics do not alias.

| Field | Takes | Default | | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `curve` | `soft`, `hard`, `asymmetric`, `fold`, `silicon`, `germanium`, `octave` | `soft` |  | The transfer curve; what it does past full scale is the character |
| `oversample` | 1 to 8 × | 4 |  | 1, 2, 4 or 8 times the rate; anything above 1 adds 22 samples of latency, the same at every factor |

## `delay`: Delay

A delay line with feedback and a dry/wet mix; bind the time to an lfo for chorus and flanging.

| Field | Takes | Default | | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `time` | 0.1 to 10000 ms | 300 | modulatable, smoothed | Delay in milliseconds; a change slides the read head, like tape |
| `feedback` | 0 to 0.99 | 0 | smoothed | How much of the delayed signal goes round again |
| `mix` | 0 to 1 | 1 | smoothed | Dry at 0, the delayed signal alone at 1 |
| `max` | 1 to 10000 ms | 2000 |  | The line's length; memory is reserved for this at prepare |
| `smooth` | 0 to 1 s | 0.02 |  | Seconds a parameter change takes to settle; 0 applies it on the next block |

## `lfo`: LFO

A low-frequency oscillator, free or synced to the tempo. Drives other nodes' fields; it carries no audio.

*source: takes no audio in; control: bind it, never wire it.*

| Field | Takes | Default | | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rate` | 0.01 to 50 Hz | 1 |  | Cycles per second when not synced |
| `shape` | `sine`, `triangle`, `square`, `saw`, `random` | `sine` |  | The wave |
| `sync` | true or false | false |  | Lock to the transport at the note value instead of the rate |
| `note` | `1/1`, `1/2`, `1/2T`, `1/4`, `1/4D`, `1/4T`, `1/8`, `1/8D`, `1/8T`, `1/16`, `1/16T`, `1/32` | `1/4` |  | Cycle length when synced, in note values |
| `depth` | 0 to 1 | 1 | smoothed | Scales the output; bindings see 0 at no depth |
| `phase` | 0 to 1 | 0 |  | Where in the cycle the wave is read, in cycles |
| `spread` | 0 to 1 | 0 |  | How far ahead the right channel reads, in cycles |
| `unipolar` | true or false | false |  | Run from 0 to 1 instead of -1 to 1, so a map's ends are the wave's |
| `smooth` | 0 to 1 s | 0.02 |  | Seconds a parameter change takes to settle; 0 applies it on the next block |

## `allpass`: Allpass

A cascade of allpass stages with feedback: flat in level, it shifts phase, and mixed with the dry signal makes the notches of a phaser.

| Field | Takes | Default | | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stages` | 1 to 16 | 4 |  | First-order allpasses in a row; each pair makes a notch when mixed with the dry signal |
| `freq` | 20 to 20000 Hz | 1000 | modulatable, smoothed | Where the phase shift is centred |
| `feedback` | 0 to 0.95 | 0 | smoothed | The cascade's output fed back to its input, which deepens the notches |
| `mix` | 0 to 1 | 1 | smoothed | Dry at 0, the shifted signal alone at 1; a phaser sits at 0.5 |
| `smooth` | 0 to 1 s | 0.02 |  | Seconds a parameter change takes to settle; 0 applies it on the next block |

## `mix`: Mix

Sums everything connected to it. Put gains in front to weight them.

*sums any number of incoming edges.*

No fields.

## `split`: Split

Passes the signal through, as a junction to fan it out from.

No fields.
